get.description: Every preference of the caller, ordered by key: the values it wrote, and under every other key the server has a default for, that default (origin role or deployment). Unpaged by design and bounded by construction: at most 256 entries of the caller's own beside the deployment's defaults, each value at most 16384 bytes of JSON.

200.description: The result.

429.description: Too many requests: a rate limit the deployment configured refused this one. Retry after the number of seconds Retry-After names.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.

404.description: Not found — also the answer to a caller the endpoint refuses, which is deliberately indistinguishable from a missing route.

default.description: A failure. The body is the framework error envelope, or the same fields as an RFC 9457 problem document when the request accepts application/problem+json, unless the server's error handler writes its own.

put.description: Writes one preference of the caller, replacing any previous value. A value longer than 16384 bytes of JSON is refused (400, preferences.encoded.too_large); a write that would add a key beyond 256 preferences is refused (409, preferences.limit.exceeded).

200.description: The result.

429.description: Too many requests: a rate limit the deployment configured refused this one. Retry after the number of seconds Retry-After names.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.

404.description: Not found — also the answer to a caller the endpoint refuses, which is deliberately indistinguishable from a missing route.

default.description: A failure. The body is the framework error envelope, or the same fields as an RFC 9457 problem document when the request accepts application/problem+json, unless the server's error handler writes its own.

post.description: Writes several preferences of the caller in one transaction, all or none, and answers the written ones ordered by key. Each entry is checked as the single write checks it (400); malformed entries are refused (400, preferences.bulk.malformed); a batch that would leave the caller holding more than 256 preferences is refused whole (409, preferences.limit.exceeded).

200.description: The result.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.

default.description: A failure. The body is the framework error envelope, or the same fields as an RFC 9457 problem document when the request accepts application/problem+json, unless the server's error handler writes its own.

delete.description: Deletes every preference of the caller in one statement. Idempotent and unconditional: a caller holding none is cleared with a 200, and there is no filter to narrow what goes.

200.description: Done; the response carries no body.
